newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel, PLO reach Hebron deal-official.
newsitem.headline: Israel, PLO reach Hebron deal-official.

text.p: Israel and the PLO signed a long-elusive agreement on Wednesday extending Palestinian rule to Hebron in the West Bank, an Israeli official said.
"The agreement has been signed a few minutes ago by (negotiators) Dan Shomron and Saeb Erekat," Shai Bazak, spokesman for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, told reporters at the Erez crossing.
The agreement was signed less than two hours after Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat began a midnight summit at Erez.
PLO officials said the initialling took place in a room without reporters.
They said a public signing ceremony attended by Israeli and Palestinian leaders along with European, Arab and American representatives would be held on Friday.
The PLO officials said the agreement stipulates an Israeli withdrawal from 80 percent of Hebron within 10 days.
